source.name: FC Arouca: 'Mudanca Historica em Arouca: Bwin e o novo main sponsor do FC Arouca' (club announcement)
source.quote: O FC Arouca inicia uma nova etapa da sua história com a entrada da bwin como Main Sponsor do clube. O acordo, válido por quatro épocas, com opção por uma quinta temporada
source.note: Wikipedia's 2026-27 Primeira Liga kit table lists Arouca's main kit sponsor as bwin, and Footy Headlines' home-kit release (2026-08-06) has 'main sponsor bwin printed across the front'. The club announcement adds: 'Depois de mais de uma década com a Construções Carlos Pinho, Lda na frente da camisola principal' - the deal replaced Construções Carlos Pinho after more than ten years.

source.name: Footy Headlines: FC Arouca 26-27 Home Kit Released
source.quote: The Skita logo is placed on the right chest in navy, sitting opposite the traditional club crest, with main sponsor bwin printed across the front.
source.note: Kit maker; not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense. Wikipedia's Arouca row also lists Skita as kit manufacturer.

summary: Front paid for by Entain plc (LSE-listed) via Bwin, on a four-season deal announced 27 Jul 2026. Back: Castro Electrónica and Construções Carlos Pinho. Sleeves: Hospital da Luz. Kit maker: Skita (partner).
